passages.note: House Third Reading: Bolick voted Yes on final passage of the 15-week gestational limit.

passages.provision_quote: Except in a medical emergency, a physician may not intentionally or knowingly perform, induce or attempt to perform or induce an abortion if the probable gestational age of the unborn human being has been determined to be greater than fifteen weeks.
passages.note: Operative provision of the signed law: bans abortion after fifteen weeks' gestation except in a medical emergency.
Bill status page lists Bolick among the co-sponsors of SB1164.

rows.reasoning: SB 1164 (2022), which Bolick co-sponsored and voted Yes on at House Third Reading, bars abortion after fifteen weeks' gestation except in a medical emergency. That cutoff is more restrictive than 'keep abortion legal through the second trimester' and more permissive than 'allow abortion during the first trimester,' so the record establishes a restrictive direction without matching either rung's stated cutoff.
